profile.headline: Sr Android Developer at Publicis Sapient
profile.summary:
Finding the best way to improve your product is always a challenge. Focusing on technology changes learning which tool is best and more approachable for your project, improving the quality and always having in mind the value that your project provides that's what it takes.

Programming: Java, Objective C, .NET Framework, HTML, PHP, Python, CSS, JS (Jquery, Bootstrap, EXTjs, Sencha Touch), Cordova, PostgresSQL, XML.

Software: IDEs (Android Studio, Xcode, Visual Studio, NetBeans, Eclipse), Web server (Apache, Wamp, Nginx), Design (UML, Database design and modeling, Adobe Illustrator) MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

System: Mac (All), Linux (Ubuntu (all)), Windows (all), IOS, Android.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked with a team of 6 developers to oversee and collaborate on the development of new Business Requirements for major Mobile Application Clients as Spirit Airlines as well as support, publishing, and maintenance. 

Designed/Developed and delivered on major architectural changes of the Spirit Mobile Application launch module.

Designed/Developed and delivered major Flight Availability module of the Spirit Mobile Application which allow user to have a better experience searching for flights.

Participated on architectural strategy definition for migration from Legacy MVP architecture to MVVM.

Participated on refining Code Review and Code Standards as well as git flow branching structure for the SDLC. 

Helped improving current CI/CD pipeline tools like SonarQube and Test Coverage – Jacoco.

Designed and developed a strategy to migrate the application to use HILT independency injection framework.

Integrated In-App review API to Mobile Application of Spirit Airlines.

Designed/Developed and delivered major DeepLink processing module to Mobile Application of Spirit Airlines.

Design/Developed Encryption/Decryption strategy for customer sensitive information in transit and locally stored in Application using Symetric/Asymetric encryption methods like RSA and AES. 

Responsible for publishing Spirit Airlines Application to more than 2 million people in the Android Play Store.

Designed/Developed a scalable solution using Dynatrace to log extra information on specific crashes to increase Crash free user % of the application.

Developed/Design integration with Branch to navigate based on application state to proper Deep Link destination. 

Designed/Developed scalable solution to address state management crashes in the Application.
positions.insights: Skills: Dynatrace · Kotlin · Coroutines · MVVM · Flow · Java · Azure DevOps Server · Confluence · AES · RSA · SonarCube · Git · GSON · Gradle · Mockk · Branch.io · Jacoco · HILT · Lucid Chart · Android Studio

positions.title: XETID
positions.description:
Main developer in a subsystem of a finance application for business accounting using EXTjs, PHP, JS, AJAX, HTML, CSS, doctrine, Zend-framework. CONFIN (Finance ERP system)

Developed a software subsystem engine to classify content for a Smart Engine for categorizing content in the University, using python, mongodb (DataBase).

Mainly participation as a DataBase and UI developer in an application that made court system files secured, streamlined processes and automatically retrievable using EXTjs, PHP, JS, AJAX, HTML, CSS.
